name: Story Quest: The Locked Library
description: A choose-your-own-adventure the whole class steers — each chapter ends in a vote that decides where the story goes.

intro.message:
📚 STORY QUEST

This story belongs to the whole class. At the end of each chapter, you vote — and the winning choice decides what happens next.

Choose carefully…

ch1.message:
The class trip ends at the old library just as the storm rolls in — and the great doors lock behind you.

A spiral staircase climbs into darkness. Behind the front desk, a trapdoor stands ajar.

tower.message: The stairs end in an attic of star maps and dust. A telescope points across a broken gap in the floor — straight at a faintly glowing book on a pedestal.

cellar.message:
The trapdoor drops you into a cellar of card catalogs. One drawer rattles on its own. Inside: a brass key, and a note — "The reading room. Midnight only."

Ahead, a faintly glowing book rests on a pedestal.

vote2.question: The glowing book is right there. What do we do?
candidates: Leave it and find the way out

take-book.message:
The moment your fingers touch the cover, every lamp in the library flares to life — and the book opens to a page titled with today's date and all of your names.

It has been waiting for this class.

leave-it.message:
You back away. Somewhere deep in the stacks, something sighs — disappointed, or maybe relieved.

The front doors click open. The book will wait for a braver class.

finale.message:
The storm has passed. As you file out, the library doors swing shut behind you — and through the window, just for a second, the glow flickers like a wink.

THE END (this time…)

end.message: 📚 Same class, different choices, different story. Play it again sometime.
